public.text: The section introduces graduated assurance but may be read as allowing weak security indefinitely in lower-capacity settings. Some minimum protections should apply irrespective of maturity.
public.suggestedRevision: Define a non-negotiable security baseline, including secure communications, least privilege, audit logging, vulnerability management, backup and recovery, incident response, and protection of administrative access. Graduated assurance should apply above that baseline.
